display_name: 固定跨RX监督对比三成员集成：30轮三种子clean
description: 两固定对比方案各三主seed组，每组复用合法成员0、从零30轮训练成员1/2，普通cos逐成员、T1等权概率。
authorization: 用户继续深入并发布实验提升性能；沿原已授权三成员固定集成，每模型30/commoncos/clean/noVgate。两方案全部进入，配置先于父单模型target汇总固定。

code.commit_notes: actual execution commit is fixed by release_commit.txt and readback; source code commit self-reference is not a gate

data.representation: received residual/post_sync/noeq clean IQ256; native CVS plus row-defined mechanism

permissions.query_use: only fixed frozen clean prediction; no query training/fit/selection; independent truth-last after every same-row readout completes
permissions.claim_scope: threeprimaryseed Phase1 clean ManySig groundproxy benchmark-exposed; no Phase2/in-orbit claim

checkpoint.provenance_verdict: parent samefullsource ownFINAL30 proof before loading; no inheritance in newtrain
checkpoint.selection_rule: every fixed arm/primary seed enters;all components FINAL30;T1 equal mean,no fitting

execution.gpu_policy: max3 total CUDA processes/GPU including other owners, capacity lock, eight GPUs
execution.stop_rule: wrong protocol/roles/checkpoint, target or U truth in training, output collision, unlaunchable or prediction/scorer closure failure; protect all unrelated workloads, retain partials; no stop/retry for low accuracy

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: same-row frozenprediction thenindependentexec truthlast;oldcontrolprovenance andsamephysicalIDs checked

rows.purpose: fixed ordinarycos ensemble variance test for bothcontrastive arms
rows.seed_notes: primarygroup seed;actualinit primary/primary+10000/primary+20000, sampler/noise primary;same originalsplit

risk_recipe.auxiliary_batch_scope: at most32 fresh source-L packets; R may separately re-encode at most32 cached audit IQ packets; count both
risk_recipe.source_selection: fixed final epoch; all three rows tested
risk_recipe.reference: periodically frozen own student; no EMA teacher
risk_recipe.action_scope: bounded post-receive linear/phase increments; no satellite simulator in training
risk_recipe.source_u_scope: No U access in any arm

source_stress.ranking: clean feasibility then stress mean+worst RX risk; descriptive source-only ranking across three seeds; within .2pp prefer fewer auxiliary parameters
source_stress.selection: three-seed source V only; clean feasibility .5pp then mean+worstRX performance; exact ties lower ratio

feature_recipe.calibration_scope: mature source-L relation buckets; fixed once, no later weight adaptation
feature_recipe.style_scope: native labeled clean CE only; no extra CE or KL
feature_recipe.statistical_ema: gradient statistics only, not an EMA teacher

source_selection.rule: fixed final epoch; every predeclared row tested; no source V epoch selection
source_selection.future_compression: USER EXPLICIT EXCEPTION: clean three-seed mean no more than 0.003 below fixed original E200 permits shorter epoch exploration
source_selection.benchmark_role: exposed development benchmark for epoch budget only; not independent blind test

reference_E200.role: comparison only; never loaded for initialization

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: epoch cosine20; same scratch source path;explicitCFO identity slot zero

multilevel.sampling: independent A/B, each same-day 6TX x 5RX x2 L, cross-batch overlap allowed
multilevel.style_scope: 4 legal sameTX/day crossRX distinctPID L style candidates; eval batch-mean CE chooses hard; random control has identical search cost; selected train forward shares clean dropout RNG

rx_action.L_fit: other five TX AND other two days
rx_action.U_fit: all six L TX, other two days; U TX never read
rx_action.critic_fit: actual deterministic CE increment on up to32L, identity detached; smoothL1; zero-action anchored
rx_action.action_selection: eight candidates: four other sourceRX times two fixed scales; no identity class prediction in bank lookup

source_loader_config.sampling: same seed-private RX/day-balanced full permutation for L and independently U; no TX grouping/hidden U labels
source_loader_config.feature_target: main identity margin sensitivities and supervised style at time_down/t2.pool

engineering.mix_layer_policy: alternate from active step445; exactly one layer per update
engineering.mix_source: L_s only; different TX donors; repeated donors allowed
engineering.labels_smoothing_scope: L identity CE only; fixed peer U targets unchanged

identity_input.raw_IQ_scope: residual frequency information is not guaranteed absent

config.initialization: members1/2 scratch; member0 inference only exact same arm/source contract

semi.target: current own student deterministic clean eval detached; changes each update
semi.history: same physical U ID and adjacent full traversal pass

contrastive.normalization: currentLbatch detachedmean/std floor1e-4 then perpacketL2 eps1e-4
contrastive.identity_protection: sameTX positives plusordinaryCE;not proof fullfutureTX preservation

ensemble.formula: uniform mean softmax logits, T1, no calibration
